about: Chorus edit (spec 2026-11-02 §5.3, then the author's post-production after the lip-sync trial). Each pass is a list of segments. A 'take' segment plays a lip-sync take at the lag motion-kit/tools/sync_check.py measured (sync = its sync.json, relative to ep01/v2); a 'still' segment is an approved plate moved by the code camera from 'from' to 'to' ([centre x, centre y, zoom] in plate px), with an optional blurred 'scrim' [x, y, w, h, alpha] in screen px behind the lyric. A later segment starts at a lyric line's vocal entry ('at_line', two frames early like build.py's vocal()) or on the last eighth note before the named take stops being in sync ('eighth_before_sync_end_of', the author's EV cut). Lyrics stay on screen. c4's edit is kept in chorus-c4.json.
